decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [insert plan numbers/documents].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.

Reason : 1 - The proposed outbuilding by inclusion of a bathroom would not be incidental to main dwellinghouse, with the potential to be used as a self-contained accommodation by current or future occupants, causing a serious and adverse effect on the amenities enjoyed by residents of that area contrary to Local Plan policy, SC7 and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines (2024) and the intent of the National Planning Policy Framework.

Reason : 2 - The proposed single storey rear extension, by reason of its height and depth would be out of scale and character with this and surrounding dwellings, as well as leading to a loss of light, outlook and increasing sense of enclosure to the neighbouring property as well as having an adverse effect on the visual amenities of the locality. Thus, it is contrary to Local Plan policies SC7, CC1, CC2 and CC4 of Local Plan and the National Planning Policy Framework

Reason : 3 - The proposed side roof extension, by reason of its size would be out of scale and character with this and surrounding dwellings, as well as having an adverse effect on the visual amenities of the locality and the character and appearance of the Grove Park conservation area. Thus, it is contrary to Local Plan policies SC7, CC1, CC2 and CC4 of Local Plan and the National Planning Policy Framework.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension, front porch extension, side roof extension with four roof windows, replacement of existing windows and doors with double glazed timber windows, erection of an outbuilding, enlargement of front access, installation of new gate and fence to the front boundary, installation of permeable paving to the front garden and installation of bike/bin storage to the house.
